text: Move the mouse to look around. (Click the game first if the mouse isn't captured.)
Walk around with W A S D.
Press {flight} to fly. Hold {ascend} to rise and {descend} to sink.
{melee}: punch. Throw three punches in a row for a combo.
Press {kiBlast} to fire a ki blast.
Hold {beam} to charge your Energy Wave, then let go to fire it.
Attacks use ki (the blue bar). Hold {charge} to charge it back up.
Hold {block} to guard and take less damage.
Press {lockOn} to lock on to the nearest enemy (press again to switch or release).
People with "!" over their head have quests. Walk up to Gokan and press {interact} to start the story.

Character, Stats, Forms and Techniques are in the bar at the bottom; {pause} pauses. {transform} transforms and {base} takes you back to base form. Bosses talk before you fight them. When a planet's story is done, a pilot ✈ flies you onward. Good luck!
